mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_merchant_settlement s JOIN dms_merchant m ON m.id=s.merchant_id WHERE s.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_merchant_settlement s JOIN dms_merchant m ON m.id=s.merchant_id WHERE s.order_item_id=#{orderItemId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_merchant_settlement s JOIN dms_merchant m ON m.id=s.merchant_id WHERE s.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY s.id
SELECT FROM dms_merchant_settlement s JOIN dms_merchant m ON m.id=s.merchant_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND s.status=#{status} ORDER BY s.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM dms_merchant_settlement WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY order_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_merchant_settlement SET status='AVAILABLE',available_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE dms_merchant_settlement SET refunded_quantity=refunded_quantity+#{quantity},reversed_amount=reversed_amount+#{amount},status=#{status},update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND refunded_quantity+#{quantity}<=quantity AND reversed_amount+#{amount}<=settlement_amount
